items.title: BoF: Demna's Gucci goes back under the microscope at Milan Fashion Week
items.summary: BoF week-ahead briefing frames Friday's show (Demna's third for the house, one year after his debut) as the moment that will show whether his creative revamp is translating into commercial traction, not just critical column inches. Notes Gucci sales are still declining even as the rate of decline narrows, and that investors and buyers alike are watching for concrete signs of stabilization rather than more spectacle.

items.title: FashionNetwork France: Gucci et Dior, un changement de style encore en chantier
items.summary: French trade outlet's one-year retrospective on the wave of creative-director changes at Chanel, Dior and Gucci finds the turnaround still a work in progress: Gucci's Q2 sales beat expectations but revenue is still falling, and Demna's first runway in February 'went darker,' narrowing the brand's apparent target customer to the very young and very thin -- a skeptical framing distinct from brand-side messaging.

items.title: WWD: Milan Fashion Week September 2026 schedule -- Gucci's Friday slot is the week's defining moment
items.summary: WWD's MFW guide singles out Gucci's Sept 25, 2 p.m. show at via Colleoni as one of the week's marquee events, describing Demna's sophomore ready-to-wear outing as set to 'set the bag conversation for a full year' after his debut drew a star-studded front row (Kate Moss, Emily Ratajkowski) but polarized critics.

items.title: Kering stock holds steady as investors look to Gucci-led recovery
items.summary: European market wire notes Kering shares easing back from late-August highs (around EUR243 vs EUR254 on Aug 31) as broader luxury-sector sentiment softens; investors are withholding conviction on a full Gucci recovery until Friday's show and further quarterly evidence, underscoring that market confidence in the turnaround remains fragile and reversible.

items.source: TikTok (#gucci discovery page, public creator posts)
items.title: TikTok: 'Gucci Morty' meme continues circulating across creator accounts into MFW week
items.summary: Ongoing viral meme trend (Rick and Morty's Morty edited into Gucci fits, originating mid-August on Instagram) continues spreading on TikTok and X into fashion-week week, used ironically as shorthand for 'aura'/coolness. Not brand-originated; a genuine organic pop-culture buzz signal loosely tied to the brand name rather than product or campaign sentiment -- reach/like counts not retrievable via the aggregated discovery page, left null.

items.title: theFashionSpot: forum members review Demna's Fall 2026 runway debut ahead of his second Milan outing
items.summary: Fashion-forum members revisit and re-litigate Demna's February debut in the run-up to Friday's second show, with a genuinely split verdict: some praise the sharper, sexier silhouette as overdue disruption, others argue it abandoned Gucci's maximalist identity and narrowed the brand's appeal to a younger, thinner customer. Included for critical-angle balance against brand-side pre-show coverage.

items.title: FashionUnited: Francesca Bellettini, the CEO forging Gucci's future
items.summary: Profile of Gucci president/CEO Francesca Bellettini published this week revisits her management reshuffle (new chief client/marketing/commercial officer role filled by ex-Bottega Veneta China head Dario Gargiulo) as the operational backbone behind Demna's creative reset, ahead of Friday's show being read as an early referendum on whether the pairing is working.
